gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, about 65 m. long, commencing at its junction with Hoi Bun Road, running along the south-eastern side of Blocks 1 and 2 of Kowloon Bay Factory Estate and terminating at its junction with Wai Yip Street, as shown coloured blue on drawing No. KH 2081/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道全長約六十五公尺，由其與海濱道會合之處起，沿九龍灣工廠大廈第一及第二座之東南部伸展，至其與偉業街會合處止，其位置經在 KH 2081/1 號圖則內用藍色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare, about 39 m. long, commencing at its junction with Hoi Bun Road, running along the north-western side of Block 2 of Kowloon Bay Factory Estate and terminating at its junction with an internal street separating Blocks 1 and 2 of the above Estate, as shown coloured yellow on drawing No. KH 2081/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道全長約三十九公尺，由其與海濱道會合之處起，沿九龍灣工廠大廈第二座之西北部伸展，至其與該大廈第一、第二座間之內街會合處止，其位置經在 KH 2081/1 號圖則內用黃色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Notice is also given that Foo Yip Street (富業街) no longer exists in the above area.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此外，上述地區內現時並無富業街。
